Expense Claim

The expense claim view displays all the details of a submitted expense claim, including the claimant's information, line items, and total amounts.

This view provides a comprehensive summary of expenses that an employee or other authorized person has incurred on behalf of the business and is seeking reimbursement for.

Available Actions

From this view, you can perform several actions:

• Click the Edit button to modify the expense claim details, add or remove line items, or update amounts

• Use the Print button to generate a printed copy of the expense claim for physical records or approval

• Process the reimbursement by creating a payment transaction directly from this view

Understanding the Display

The expense claim view shows key information including the claim date, reference number, and the person who paid for the expenses.

Line items are displayed in a table format showing each expense with its description, account allocation, and amount.

If tax codes are applied, the tax amounts will be shown in a separate column when enabled.

To learn how to create or edit expense claims, see: Expense Claim — Edit
